source: steward strategy ruling at /features-deliver EPIC-7 pre-run (job-5)
delivery_model: Per-card, one council-runner per card, sequential — never two runners at once against the same board. EV-15 and EV-16 each run the full /council loop in their own container; EV-16's working seats conduct the EV-16/EV-17 shared design pass and record its outcome in both card files without changing EV-17's state; product-owner then ratifies EV-17 Backlog -> Ready; EV-17 runs as the third and final runner.

promotion_gate.precondition: EV-16's shared design pass names the EV-17 cancel affordance and the pass is recorded in both cards

rationale: EV-15 -> EV-16 is a soft copy-surface seam (run EV-15 first so EV-16 does not author rows EV-15 then deletes). EV-16 -> EV-17 is a hard gate written into both cards' Acceptance; EV-17 cannot be Ready before the pass. Per-card rather than batched because EV-15 is a resolution/precedence behavior change and EV-16 is a surface/copy change that also gates EV-17's promotion.
ending_condition: Run closes Done when EV-15, EV-16, and EV-17 are all merged Done with gates SUCCESS on the merged SHA, and EPIC-7 Acceptance holds: bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0, bun test green, AGENTS.md config table + docs/PI-SPEC.md 7.2/8 synced.
fallback_ending: If product-owner declines the EV-17 promotion, or EV-17 exhausts its <=3 verify->fix cycles red, the run closes after EV-16 with EPIC-7 left un-Done and EV-17 named as an explicit residual (back to Backlog, not retired, not silently dropped) and the epic goal's cancellation clause announced unmet.
constraints: One runner per card; never two runners in flight at once.
EV-16's runner may write the design-pass block into EV-17's card but must not change EV-17's state.
Promotion Backlog -> Ready is product-owner's judgment, not steward's; steward only sequences and gates it.
No card retired, no child re-sliced.
Phase-1 rulings are binding: surface copy delegated, EV-16 browserOpenFailed text fixed, DEFAULT_SERVER_URL/resolveServerUrl fixed, uncertainty display card-level, gate verdict information-only.
The --admin merge bypass and direct-record push to main are authorized for this run only.
